pitot_static.pitot: probe on the nose, reads the free-stream total pressure
pitot_static.static: flush ports on both sides of the forward fuselage, cross-connected
pitot_static.ground_lag_test: first-order time constant of each line with its transducer, measured in the aircraft on the runway of the test site just before the flight, the cabin already at the temperature it kept in flight
pitot_static.line_routing: the lines run inside the pressurised cabin from the probes to the transducers

site.frame: east and north in metres from the runway threshold; heights in metres above mean sea level
